strufertārĭi , ōrum, m.,
I.they who make offerings near a tree that has been struck by lightning: “strufertarios dicebant, qui quaedam sacrificia ad arbores fulguritas faciebant, a ferto scilicet, quodam sacrificii genere,” Fest. p. 295 Müll.; cf. id. s. v. ferctum, p. 85.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
